node.title: Re: Move a file to another directory based on regex match
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: The error message is strange, but I do see one issue with your code: [doc://readdir] returns just the filenames without the directory name. I'd recommend you use File::Spec::Functions qw/catfile/; and move( catfile($InDir,$Infile), $OutDir ). If that fixes the issue, then perhaps the error message is just wrong (is this Windows or some OS other than *NIX?), and if it's doesn't fix the issue, please let us know Update: along with more information about $InDir and $OutDir. Also, [id://111088]!
